_metadata.title: Research-enriched smartphone component market reference values
_metadata.value_semantics: model_values are current online replacement-part asking-price benchmarks selected from cited listings. They are NOT guaranteed used-part resale values, recycler payouts, or recoverable-material values.
_metadata.important_caveat: Online parts prices are volatile and depend on OEM/service-pack vs aftermarket quality, condition, region, stock, and whether a listing is part-only or a repair kit. Re-check sources before publication, commercial quoting, or automated purchasing.
_metadata.app_compatibility: The numeric model_values mapping is retained for the Streamlit app. Detailed provenance lives under model_value_details.
